name: Asaka Miwa
source:
Taichi's wife. The heroine of this work. A civil servant who works at the same office as Taichi.
Raised by strict parents, she has lived by studying hard. However, when she entered college, she had relationships with various men due to the reaction that had been suppressed. After graduating from university, she settled down and became acquainted with Taichi and got married. 

I sometimes remember the intense sexual experiences of the past, but I am happy with my current marriage.
